title: Telangana Aarogyasri employee/family health pathways Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health assurance access under Telangana's Aarogyasri system for eligible beneficiary categories.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current Telangana Aarogyasri beneficiary and category rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Telangana Aarogyasri employee/family health pathways.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
